'''Hestrian wine''' was a type of [[Wine/Legends|wine]]. [[Minas Derel]] used a case of Hestrian wine to convince [[Imperial Prefect]] [[Adrona]] to renew [[Moxin Tark]]'s [[Sector Permit]] for three hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
